name: Jonkoping County (Sweden)

colors.symbolism: the chief with the three crowns, and the wavy base

description: A banner of the county arms: a blue chief bearing three golden crowns above a red field with a white three-towered castle rising from blue and white waves.
history: The flag is the heraldic banner of the arms of Jönköping County, formally granted in 1942, which combine the lesser state arms of Sweden (three crowns) with the arms of the town of Jönköping (a castle on waves).

features.role: banner of the arms of Jonkoping County
